parsed.rationale: Mild scratchy throat <48h in a young adult with no fever, no dysphagia, and no red flags is consistent with a self-limited viral or irritant pharyngitis; OTC measures (lozenges, warm fluids, saltwater gargles, acetaminophen/ibuprofen) are appropriate. Escalate if fever, worsening pain, trouble swallowing/breathing, or symptoms persist beyond ~7 days.
